Establish the requirements for performing and documenting Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSRs).
A PSSR will confirm, at a minimum, that:
Construction and modifications are performed in accordance with design specifications and meet the requirements specified by the associated Management of Change (MOC), if applicable.
Recommendations from a Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) or Hazard Screening Review (HSR) are resolved or implemented.
Equipment and assets are inspected, tested, calibrated, etc., in accordance with design specifications.
Affected employees are notified or trained.
The asset is ready for commissioning and startup.
Post startup deliverables are identified and assigned.
A PSSR is required:
In conjunction with every MOC.
Prior to startup of any new asset.
Prior to startup of an existing asset has been out of service for any length of time.
Prior to startup of an existing asset has been in standby for 12 or more months.
Before returning existing assets to service when removed from

section_results.title: Purpose
section_results.original_content:
Establish the requirements for performing and documenting Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSRs).
A PSSR will confirm, at a minimum, that:
Construction and modifications are performed in accordance with design specifications and meet the requirements specified by the associated Management of Change (MOC), if applicable.
Recommendations from a Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) or Hazard Screening Review (HSR) are resolved or implemented.
Equipment and assets are inspected, tested, calibrated, etc., in accordance with design specifications.
Affected employees are notified or trained.
The asset is ready for commissioning and startup.
Post startup deliverables are identified and assigned.
A PSSR is required:
In conjunction with every MOC.
Prior to startup of any new asset.
Prior to startup of an existing asset has been out of service for any length of time.
Prior to startup of an existing asset has been in standby for 12 or more months.
Before returning existing assets to service when removed from service for:
Non-routine repairs
Significant maintenance
Otherwise disassembled (e.g., cavern workover, compressor overhaul, equipment, piping, vessels etc. which were opened or disassembled for inspection etc.)
A PSSR may be required even if an MOC is not.
For additional guidance on effectively executing the PSSR process for large-scale projects or for phased startup of complex projects or jobs, see MOC Guidance.
Applies to: All Company Facilities

section_results.title: Execute PSSR
section_results.original_content:
PSSR Originator:
CREATE the PSSR record in Maximo and determine applicable Pre- and Post-Startup actions.
If using the F09-003 (paper) for subsequent PSSRs (instead of F09-003A (Maximo)):
Use the Action Item Tracker to record Post-Startup Deliverables.
Refer to Management of Change (MOC) and Pre-Startup Safety Review (PSSR) Task Guidance for additional detail and resources for each line item and deliverable, including:
When an item is required
The responsibilities associated with each item
Recommended or required assignees
Associated due dates, if applicable
PSSR Originator; PSSR Coordinator; Project Manager:
ASSIGN all required Pre- and Post-Startup actions to individuals qualified to complete the tasks.
Due dates for Post-Startup actions will be automatically assigned on F09-003A (Maximo app) once PSSR is placed in service.
If using paper F09-003 (paper)
Use the Action Item Tracker to assign Post-Startup Deliverables and due dates.
If Post-Startup action due dates need extended:
Refer to 12.02.00.06 – Action Item Management.
PSSR Action Assignees:
COMPLETE assigned Pre-Startup actions.
ATTACH or LINK to relevant documentation verifying completion of the task, as applicable.
Manager, Operations:
REVIEW the completeness of the PSSR, including:
Supporting documentation
Validation, identification, and assignment of Post-Startup action items
VERIFY that training roster or communication is completed and attached to the PSSR.
May use F01-103 – Training and Communication Verification for SSPs, Emergency and Response Plans and MOC-PSSR Training to document that affected employees and contractors have been informed or trained.
Each individual must be informed or trained prior to operating the equipment.
All Employees do NOT have to be informed or trained prior to startup.
The roster or communication should identify all Employees informed or trained on the process, change, or startup.
APPROVE or REJECT the PSSR.
PSSR Action Assignees:
COMPLETE assigned Post-Start actions.
ATTACH or LINK to relevant documentation verifying completion of the task, as applicable.
PSSR Coordinator; Project Manager:
VERIFY that all Post-Startup actions are completed:
ATTACH all completion documentation to the PSSR record
If using the F09-003 (paper):
Make sure that all PSSR documentation is attached to the MOC record in Maximo.
CLOSE the PSSR.
